const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const { add, parse } = require('./math');
const { assertValidTree } = require('./helpers');

test('adds numbers', () => {
  assert.equal(add(1, 2), 3);
});

test('rejects bad input', async () => {
  await assert.rejects(() => parse('x'), /bad/);
});

it('matches the snapshot', () => {
  expect(parse('{}')).toMatchSnapshot();
});

test('property: add is commutative', () => {
  for (const [a, b] of [[1, 2], [3, 4]]) assert.equal(add(a, b), add(b, a));
});

test('custom helper', () => {
  assertValidTree(parse('{}'));
});

test('regex inside a body', () => {
  assert.ok(/x/.test(parse('x').name));
});
